method: Actual cold-hash Stockfish 18 lite and Maia3. Selector 12/10, independent oracle 16/15. Fixed corpus, no fixture-specific engine logic.
preparationDefinition: Selected own setup moves reach the fixture bait within the applicable independent-oracle risk caps. Supplied human setup moves lose at most 100cp per move at depth 16; the tempting reply permits at least 80cp gain and the named first punishment is within 50cp of best. Baits outside the explicit risk budget are rejected, and permitted concessions are reported.
limitation: A narrow fixed-corpus behavioral calibration, not a rating or general trap-rate estimate. Book-assisted and search-only preparation are reported separately.

corpus.name: Légal after h3 / Bh5
corpus.notes: Named move is a reference, not an obligation. Sound alternatives remain acceptable.

corpus.name: Premature Légal sacrifice
corpus.notes: Bxd1 loses to mate, but Nxe5 can instead win a knight for Black; reject excessive objective risk.

corpus.name: Blackburne Shilling bait
corpus.notes: Famous bait is objectively dubious; selecting a normal developing move can be correct.

corpus.name: Fishing Pole hook
corpus.notes: One tempting capture is not a forced win; the model should weigh alternative human replies.

corpus.name: Englund queen fork
corpus.notes: Requires several later mistakes; the initial Bd2 reply is a correct defense, and a one-reply model should not count the full trap as certain.
